visual_logic.surface_detail: Rugged, battle-scarred 'Slate Grey' skin. Visible musculature beneath the skin to emphasize power over speed.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the 'Apex Predator' jaw filled with massive, robust teeth and the largest eyes in the animal kingdom (25cm diameter).
visual_logic.environment: Turbulent Early Jurassic coastal waters with kicked-up silt and 'Pyrite Gold' mineral glints.
visual_logic.pose: Directly engaging a smaller Ichthyosaurus; the jaws are wide, and the massive eye is focused intently on the target.
